title: Spicy Pao Chicken Stir Fry
description: A spicy and savory stir fry made with marinated chicken and peanuts, served with steamed vegetables.

instructions.step: 1. In a medium bowl, whisk together pao sauce, soy sauce, brown sugar, and garlic. Add the chicken and marinate for at least 30 minutes.

2. Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes. Remove from the skillet and set aside.
3. In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil. Add the chopped peanuts and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until fragrant.
4. Add the broccoli to the skillet and cook until tender, about 3-5 minutes.
5. Return the cooked chicken to the skillet and stir in the pao sauce mixture. Bring to a simmer and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened.
6. Season with salt and serve immediately.
